newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chu Kong sees HK$60mln interest from float.
newsitem.headline: Chu Kong sees HK$60mln interest from float.

text.p: Chu Kong Shipping Development Co Ltd expects the interest income from subscription monies of its public offering to amount to more than HK$60 million.

"The interest income is seen to be more than HK$60 million. It will be added into our general working capital for the group's development," said the company's managing director Jackie Hwang at a media luncheon on Thursday.
Chu Kong Shipping, whose shares are expected to begin trading on Friday, has said its initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong was 480 times subscribed.
The company offered 187.5 million shares at HK$1.20 each, of which 18.75 million shares were reserved for employees.

Chu Kong Shipping has said net proceeds would be used to expand the Guangfo Expressway, buy new tractors and trailers, buy two new vessels, open new agency offices in China's Pearl River Delta, upgrade computer facilities, to cut debt and for working capital.
